umbraPerception.Name: Magical darkness casts shadows
umbraPerception.Hint: Looking through a magical darkness lowers the light level of everything viewed through it to the darkness's own level.

gmObserverMode.Name: GM sees token vision
gmObserverMode.Hint: When enabled, selecting a token as GM shows you what that token perceives. Can also be toggled from the token controls button.

readoutEnabled.Name: Show light level
readoutEnabled.Hint: Displays the light level under the cursor or of a hovered token as a tooltip beside the pointer.

readoutGmOnly.Name: Light level is GM only
readoutGmOnly.Hint: Disables the light level readout for non-GM users.

readoutDetail.Name: Light level details
readoutDetail.Hint: Includes explanations to the light level tooltip when multiple sources affects the value. I.e. 'reduced from normal', 'darkness cancelled by daylight'. GM only.

fuelConsumption.Name: Fuel use
fuelConsumption.Hint: What happens when a lit light source expends its fuel.
fuelConsumption.both: Remove the fuel and announce it
fuelConsumption.announce: Announce it only, and leave the fuel alone

visualsConfig.Name: Visuals
visualsConfig.Label: Configure Visuals
visualsConfig.Hint: How bright each light tier is drawn, and how softly the boundaries between them fade.

spillConfig.Name: Light Spill
spillConfig.Label: Configure Light Spill
spillConfig.Hint: Allows light to pass through doors and windows into regions with adjusted darkness levels (interior spaces).

presetEditor.Name: Lighting Presets
presetEditor.Label: Edit Presets
presetEditor.Hint: Preset light and darkness configurations offered on a light's Lighting Configuration section.

lightItemEditor.Name: Light Sources
lightItemEditor.Label: Edit Light Sources
lightItemEditor.Hint: Which items give off light when lit, what they give off, and what they burn.

toggleReadout.Name: Toggle light level readout
toggleReadout.Hint: Show or hide the light level tooltip.

toggleGmObserverMode.Name: Toggle GM observer view
toggleGmObserverMode.Hint: Switch between the god's-eye view and the selected token's point of view.

Mode.Label: Mode
Mode.Hint: Sets restriction as a maximum value, minimum value, or static value

Tier.Label: Light level
Tier.Hint: The ambient level within the region. Light sources, darkness sources, and light spill are all unaffected by this level.

Levels.Hint: Darkness value at each tier of brightness. 0 is maximum brightness and 1 is unlit. Supernatural darkness mirrors the level of dark.

TransitionWidth.Label: Brightness transition width
TransitionWidth.Hint: length of brightness transitions in grid squares. 0 makes all light level transitions hard boundaries.

UnseenDimming.Label: Unseen ground dimming
UnseenDimming.Hint: How far explored ground outside your current vision is darkened.

DarkSightBrightness.Label: See-in-darkness brightness
DarkSightBrightness.Hint: Adjusts how bright terrain looks to a creature with see in darkness or true seeing. Foundry lightens this vision type by default. Negative values dim it back towards normal vision.

Reset.Title: Restore default visuals
Reset.Body: Put every number in this window back to the module's own values?

Spill.Title: Configure Light Spill

Enable.Label: Enable light spill
Enable.Hint: Allows light to pass through open doors and windows into regions with adjusted darkness levels. This light can spread around corners and fill spaces.

Falloff.Hint: How far each brightness tier carries indoors before it drops to the next tier, measured by shortest available path. Brightness begins at the ambient level of the scene, reduced by darkness sources covering the opening.
Falloff.Total: Bright light through a window will reach {bright} + {normal} + {dim} = {total} ft in total (updates on save).

Accuracy.Label: Grid resolution
Accuracy.Hint: How large the cells of the grid the flood fill algorithm uses (in pixels). Recommend using an even divisor of a scene's grid size for better wall alignment. Lower values exponentially increase computation time, but larger values create inaccuracies along walls, and may miss smaller windows and doors.

Reset.Title: Restore default light spill
Reset.Body: Reset light spill settings back to the module's own values?

Spill.Saved: PF1 Lighting | {count} light spill setting(s) updated.

Presets.Title: Lighting Presets

Which.Hint: Changing a preset here does not alter any existing lights.

Presets.Name: Name

Remove.Title: Delete preset
Remove.Body:
Delete {label}?

Lights already placed from it keep their settings and will simply read as Custom.

Reset.Title: Restore default presets
Reset.Body:
Discard this world's preset table and go back to the module's own?

The world will then track the built-in presets as the module changes them.

Presets.EditHint: Opens the light configuration menu for this preset.

LightConfig.PresetHint: Fills in the fields below. Changing any of them afterwards sets this back to Custom, and it stays Custom until a preset is chosen again.
LightConfig.SourceHint: Darkness types lower the light level in its area instead of raising it.
LightConfig.MagicalHint: Magical light of a higher level than a darkness overrides it.
LightConfig.DaylightHint: Annihilates with a darkness of its own level or lower - both effects vanish where they overlap.
LightConfig.BrightnessHint: The level this light provides outright, out to that radius.
LightConfig.IncreaseHint: Beyond the inner radius the light raises whatever tier is already present by that many steps, up to maximum.
LightConfig.DarkLevelHint: Mundane darkens without shadowing areas beyond. Level 1 and higher casts an umbra, darkening areas viewed through it to match its own darkness level.
LightConfig.EffectHint: Set level to will only reduce light levels, not raise it. Floor is the darkest this can drive an area.

Activation.Label: Active when scene is
Activation.Hint: The light switches off outside this range, tested against the scene's ambient light level. Bright down to Dark means the light is never disabled by ambient light.
Activation.HandSet: This light's stored range was set by hand and does not line up with these levels; choosing either will replace it.

SceneConfig.Label: Light level
SceneConfig.Drifted: This scene's stored darkness does not match its tier - saving will bring it into line.
SceneConfig.Locked: Darkness is locked on this scene, so this cannot be changed.

Readout.Unseen: out of sight behind a wall

Notify.PerceptionOn: PF1 Lighting | Perception by light level enabled.
Notify.PerceptionOff: PF1 Lighting | Perception by light level disabled.
Notify.SuppressionOn: PF1 Lighting | Native darkness suppression disabled.
Notify.SuppressionOff: PF1 Lighting | Native darkness suppression restored.
Notify.RendererOff: PF1 Lighting | Renderer is disabled - enable 'Render the lighting model' in settings.
Notify.RendererNeedsSuppression: PF1 Lighting | Renderer needs 'Disable native darkness suppression' to also be on.
Notify.NothingPainted: PF1 Lighting | nothing painted yet - the renderer may be off.
Notify.NoUmbra: PF1 Lighting | No umbra - needs perception on, an observer without see-in-darkness, and a magical (level >= 1) darkness source.
Notify.SceneDarknessLocked: PF1 Lighting: darkness is locked on {scene}, so its light level cannot be changed.
Notify.ScenesLocked: PF1 Lighting: {count} scene(s) have darkness locked and were left unchanged.

Effects.Title: Light Effects
Effects.Empty: Nothing on this scene is carrying a light effect.
Effects.Label: Light
Effects.NoExpiryTip: Lasts until something puts it out.
Effects.Reaped: PF1 Lighting | {count} orphaned light effects cleared.

Items.Title: Light Sources
Items.WhichHint: Items matched by name. An item with its own light configuration ignores this list.
Items.Name: Item name
Items.NameHint: Matched against the item's name, case insensitive.
Items.AliasesHint: Other names to identify the item by, separated by semicolons.
Items.Duplicate: PF1 Lighting | Two light sources are both called "{name}". Rename one before saving.

Remove.Title: Delete light source
Remove.Body:
Delete {label}?

Items of that name stop being offered in the token light picker unless they carry their own light settings.

Reset.Title: Restore default light sources
Reset.Body:
Discard this world's light source list and go back to the module's default?

The world will only apply updates from the module if it matches the default.

Emits.ActiveHint: While this buff is active, its actor's tokens emit light or darkness as configured. Emissions only take effect when enabled.
Emits.LitHint: Offers this item in the token light picker. This overrides whatever the light source table says about an item of this name.
Emits.PresetHint: The lighting preset this gives off. Edit the presets themselves under Configure Settings.
Emits.FuelHint: The item consumed while this burns, and how many hours one of them lasts. Name this item itself for something that consumes itself, such as a torch. Leave the name blank to burn indefinitely.

Fuel.Would: {actor}'s {light} has expended {count} × {fuel}. Automatic use is switched off, items must be removed manually.
Fuel.RanDry: {actor}'s {light} used its last {fuel} and has gone out.

Socket.NoGM: No GM is connected: lighting change was not made.
